provider: DataCite Public REST API (metadata) for 4TU.ResearchData STORM IBTrACS v4
api_version: DataCite Public REST API v2; singleton DOI 10.4121/12706085.v4

request_contract.parameter_rules: DOCUMENTATION-ONLY, NOT AN AUTHORIZED LIVE PROBE. One exact anonymous DataCite GET metadata record for DOI 10.4121/12706085.v4 is documented. Do not add query parameters, paging, search, arbitrary DOI, host, redirects, API tokens or caller-selected URL; the offline validator takes locally captured bytes and independent SHA-256. No 4TU file-list, download, or track-byte request is authorized by this contract.

response_contract.format: DataCite public singleton DOI JSON:API metadata response (data.type=dois, exact data.id and attributes.doi).
response_contract.scientific_semantics: This DOI identifies STORM IBTrACS present-climate v4, a 10,000-synthetic-year tropical-cyclone track catalogue. Version v4 corrects past track-duplication and storm-category mistakes. A DataCite JSON record neither enumerates exact downloadable v4 files nor verifies their native schema, units, storm/year identity or hashes. Synthetic tracks are not observed storm records; tracks alone are not spatial wind/surge footprints or insured losses.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No live DataCite call is authorized by this documentation-only contract. DataCite public singleton DOI access is documented; any T1 request requires a separate terms and bounded execution review, no bulk harvesting, redirects, arbitrary query, retry or polling.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: DOI version is fixed, but its mutable public metadata and links must not be mistaken for immutable versioned track files. A future receipt must retain retrieval UTC, exact URL, response byte count, SHA-256, parsed DOI/title/rights/version and separate 4TU original-file listing, size and SHA-256 once independently approved.

rights_and_policy.notes: The existing admitted manifest and 2022 VU institutional v4 record identify STORM v4 as CC0-1.0 for the dataset; this does not make DataCite API automation terms reviewed or approve repository publication of any particular track file. The provider file-byte scope remains metadata-only until a separate exact asset review.

notes: One bounded DOI-metadata route for already reviewed source storm.ibtracs.present-climate.v4; offline reader research_runners/storm_v4_datacite_preflight_v0.py validates raw response identity and independent SHA-256, with synthetic tests. No original STORM file or provider response has been fetched, stored in Git, or admitted as hazard/model input by this work.
